title: Criteria/matrix mismatch
text: Criteria/matrix mismatch: excluding `edited` means an open non-draft PR retargeted from another base to `develop` receives no Ronda review until another listed event occurs, contradicting the stated “every non-draft PR targeting develop” behavior. GitHub represents PR base changes through the `edited` activity. Handle base-ref edits while filtering unrelated title/body edits, and add an isolating planted-violation proof for that path. [GitHub event documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/events-that-trigger-workflows)
rationale: Real gap: a PR retargeted to develop gets no review until another event. Accepted and documented as a known limitation in dogfood-evidence-103. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
